notes.title: New update available!
notes.content:
We have ported improvements to the SteamVR version from the Pico Neo 3 version.

If you have any questions or feedback, please use the community forums :)

Bug fixes:
- fixed aiming and placement of cubes
- fixed minor issues

notes.title: Update Notes May 3rd
notes.content:
Quest for Runia got an update today! 

We have ported countless improvements to the SteamVR version from the Oculus Quest App Lab version.

We hope you enjoy playing Quest for Runia even more!

If you have any questions or feedback, please use the community forums!

Improvements:
- Evergreen Isles level 27 difficulty lowered
- added missing Windows Mixed Reality controller bindings
- many stability and performance improvements

Bug fixes:
- fixed floating plants in some parts of the environments
- fixed various minor issues
